answer: Require re-derivation. Every rewarded claim must carry its inputs and the path to its conclusion, so any verifier can walk the same bridge and reach the same result. Claims that cannot be re-derived are not graded harshly — they are not graded at all: an answer nobody can reproduce is indistinguishable from a dune, a shape that dissolves on approach. Farms can mint a thousand confident outputs, but each must carry its derivation, and fabrications leave no trail. Real work has a pulse you can find and follow; the protocol refuses to pay for heartbeats it cannot locate.
